incident: Confluence Exploit (CVE-2023-22527) Leads to LockBit Ransomware (TTR 2h06m)

sources.title: Confluence Exploit Leads to LockBit Ransomware - The DFIR Report (2025-02-24)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (CVE-2023-22527 Confluence RCE -> mshta Metasploit -> AnyDesk), hops (all RDP from beachhead to backup, file, DC, Exchange), cred access (Mimikatz, Veeam-Get-Creds on backup server), exfil (Rclone from file server to Mega), impact (LockBit manual + PDQ Deploy over SMB + Exchange C$ failsafe), TTR 2h06m

narrative_before: In this 2025 intrusion the DFIR Report observed exploitation of CVE-2023-22527 (Confluence RCE) on a Windows server. The actor ran net user/whoami, used mshta to fetch a Metasploit stager, then downloaded and installed AnyDesk with a preset password for persistence. They created a new local admin account, RDPed into the beachhead with it and ran Mimikatz, then used SoftPerfect NetScan to enumerate hosts. They moved by RDP to a backup server (default Administrator) and ran Veeam-Get-Creds-New.ps1 to extract Veeam credentials, then pivoted by RDP to a file server, deployed Rclone and exfiltrated data to MEGA.io (clearing event logs afterward). They RDPed to a domain controller with domain admin creds and enumerated admins. They then launched LockBit: manual execution on the backup and file servers over RDP, then PDQ Deploy on the beachhead to distribute the binary + asd.bat over SMB to remote hosts, and finally pivoted to an Exchange server, stopped services, and ran a batch script mounting remote C$ shares as a secondary encryption wave. TTR was just over 2 hours (02:06:14). All RDP was from the beachhead.

detection_moments.description: CVE-2023-22527 exploited on the Confluence server; discovery (net user/whoami); mshta Metasploit stager; AnyDesk installed with preset password.
detection_moments.evidence: 'the exploitation of CVE-2023-22527, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Confluence ... pivoted to using mshta to retrieve a remote HTA file containing a Metasploit stager ... download and install AnyDesk' - Confluence Exploit, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: Mimikatz + netscan on beachhead; RDP to backup server (Veeam creds), file server (Rclone exfil to Mega), and DC (domain admin, admin enumeration).
detection_moments.evidence: 'executed a PowerShell script, Veeam-Get-Creds-New.ps1, to extract Veeam credentials ... deployed Rclone to exfiltrate data to MEGA.io ... pivoted to a domain controller via RDP using domain administrator credentials' - Confluence Exploit

detection_moments.description: TTR 2h06m: LockBit run manually on backup+file servers, PDQ Deploy distributes the binary over SMB, and an Exchange batch script mounts remote C$ as a failsafe encryption wave.
detection_moments.evidence: 'manually executing the ransomware on a backup server and a file share server ... leveraged PDQ Deploy ... distributed the ransomware binary and a batch script to remote hosts over SMB ... mount remote systems' C$ shares, effectively enabling a secondary encryption wave' - Confluence Exploit
